  - `q36-intake`: ours — Candidate расширяет SIZES до пяти setup-моделей реальными KAT/Huihui GGUF-заголовками; FILE_SIZES оставляет три официальных имени.

### `751d55647f36` — fix(inkling cuda): the auto prefill chunk leaves room for the K/V that still has to grow (regression fix for faceebb50)

- Дата: 2026-11-23
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `engine/include/strata/core/ink_chunk.hpp` (+9/-5)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/cuda/ink_cuda_backend.cu` (+6/-3)
  - `engine/tests/core/ink_chunk_test.cpp` (+8/-0)

- Связанные решения:
  - Прямого решения в matrix нет; изменение принято как upstream-база.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
faceebb50 chose the chunk from the memory left after the experts only. On a 24 GB card with UD-Q4_K_XL at 32K the 1024 chunk took the room the
global K/V needs to grow, so the K/V tail went to host RAM and decode at 30K tokens fell with 2 slots from 80.9 to 36.0 tok/s (3 slots 14.7).

The chunk now also has to leave slots x (context - the window allocated at start) x bytes per position free (none when K/V offload is on).
RTX 4090, UD-Q4_K_XL, 32K, decode tok/s at 30K tokens, 1 / 2 / 3 slots:
  faceebb50          87.7 / 36.0 / 14.7
  this change        86.6 / 79.8 / 24.0
  STRATA_INK_CHUNK_AUTO=0 (chunk 512, the old default) 87.7 / 80.9 / 25.4
3 slots spill by the engine's own auto host-offload decision, not by the chunk (the same with the old default).
ink_chunk_test covers the three cases.
```

### `479b9bcf5e43` — fix(inkling cuda): growing the global K/V never ends the engine; the host tail is the whole rest of the context (#6905)

- Дата: 2026-11-23
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `engine/include/strata/core/ink_kv_grow.hpp` (+6/-0)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/cuda/ink_cuda_backend.cu` (+5/-0)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/cuda/ink_runner.cuh` (+7/-1)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/ink_backend.h` (+4/-0)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/ink_serve.h` (+15/-0)
  - `engine/tests/core/ink_kv_grow_test.cpp` (+11/-0)
  - `terminal/strata_control/inkling_fit.py` (+5/-1)
  - `terminal/tests/terminal/test_inkling_kv_headroom.py` (+39/-0)
  - `terminal/tests/terminal/test_no_debugger_children.py` (+2/-2)

- Связанные решения:
  - Прямого решения в matrix нет; изменение принято как upstream-база.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
#6905 (RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, SQ-10, 64K, vision): another program took VRAM after the start, the K/V could not grow in the card, the engine spilled a host tail
sized to just the request that hit the limit, and the next, longer request ended the engine ("VRAM exhausted growing elastic global KV cache to 40961 tokens").

- ensure_global_kv_cap maps the WHOLE rest of the context to pinned host RAM when the card cannot grow (ink_kv_host_tail_full); only when that does not fit in
  host memory it falls back to the request's own size (ink_kv_host_tail_need).
- When the K/V cannot grow at all (K/V offload off, no host RAM), ink_serve ends only the requests whose positions are past the K/V's capacity (reason
  "length") and goes on; every other forward failure is still fatal.
- Planner: on CUDA with K/V over 1 GB and offload auto, the K/V stays in the card only with 0.5 GB to spare (KV_CARD_HEADROOM_GB); the reporter's plan
  (SQ-10, 15.9 GiB, 64K, vision: 0.4 GB to spare) now keeps all experts in the card and puts the K/V on the host.
- test_no_debugger_children: setup.py has one more listed process (vm_stat, added by 7a1467e21 without the count).

RTX 4090, SQ-10, max context 131072, a hog takes all but 1100 MiB after the engine is ready, requests of 20K / 45K / 60K / 100K tokens:
  before: 20K answered, 45K "ERR fatal GPU error: VRAM exhausted growing elastic global KV cache to 36383 tokens", engine gone (spill 20224 + 12544 host)
  after:  all four answered, then a short one again (spill 18432 + 112640 host = 131072)
Tests: ink_kv_grow_test (host tail), test_inkling_kv_headroom, 158 planner/launch tests on p2006.
```

### `e06542eea0cf` — fix(launch): Inkling on NVIDIA defaults to the number of slots whose K/V stays on the card, not the VRAM table's

- Дата: 2026-11-23
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `terminal/strata_cli/launch/runner.py` (+17/-0)
  - `terminal/strata_control/inkling_fit.py` (+30/-0)
  - `terminal/tests/terminal/test_inkling_launch_parallel.py` (+112/-0)

- Связанные решения:
  - Прямого решения в matrix нет; изменение принято как upstream-база.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
The launch's slot default came from the VRAM table (24 GB: 3). Each slot reserves K/V for the whole context, so 3 slots of UD-Q4_K_XL at 32K do not fit
next to the experts of a 24 GB card: the engine keeps part of every slot's K/V on the host and a decode step after 30K tokens reads it over PCIe
(Olares, RTX 5090 Laptop 24 GB: 86.3 / 81.7 / 44.3 tok/s at a short prompt / 4K / 30K).

inkling_fit.resident_parallel(): the largest slot count whose plan keeps kv_offload off with the same expert share as one slot (never below 1).
inkling_fit.launch_parallel(): min(table, resident_parallel) with the screen reserve. fit_parallel_for() uses it for inkling-2-mini on NVIDIA; an explicit
--parallel is never touched, other families and other vendors keep the table, an unknown build keeps the table.

RTX 4090, UD-Q4_K_XL, 32K, decode tok/s at 4K / 30K tokens (751d55647 chunk rule):
  1 slot  95.7 / 86.6
  2 slots 87.2 / 79.8   <- the launch's new default on a 24 GB card
  3 slots 94.6 / 24.0   <- the table's default: K/V tail on the host
```

### `3f57f139d7e1` — probe: the placement key no longer contains the slot count (rc1 started --draft off above 1 slot)

- Дата: 2026-11-23
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `terminal/strata_control/inkling_probe.py` (+7/-4)
  - `terminal/tests/terminal/test_inkling_probe.py` (+25/-3)

- Связанные решения:
  - Прямого решения в matrix нет; изменение принято как upstream-база.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
GRID's same-box A/B on a DGX Spark (SQ-20, one request): 0.2.20 drafter on 34.7 tok/s against 31.7 off, rc1 "on" 29.7 = off 29.7. The engine start lines of every rc1
cell were `--parallel 4 --draft off` (and `--parallel 32 --draft off`) with "DSpark took 0 MiB", while the one probe record that exists (probe at 1 slot) said on, x1.39.

Cause: the slot count of `strata launch` is a profile override (runner.ensure_profile, parallel=N). The runner's probe hook reads the run config file (parallel 1) and
records the decision with placement_key(file config); the real start reads file + override (parallel 4 / 32), so placement_key differs, decision_of() is None, wants_drafter()
is False for "auto" and engine_args appends --draft off. The probe never re-runs because the hook never sees the override. Every launch with the default 2 to 4 slots lost the
drafter. The engine drafts only while exactly one request is active, so a probe that decodes one request describes a lone request at 1 slot and at 32 alike; what the slots
change in memory is already in the key through --vram-experts-gb / --ram-experts-gb / --kv / --gpus / --max-context.

Fix: placement_key and _PLACEMENT_FLAGS drop parallel / --parallel. A probe made at one slot holds at the slots of the real start; a change of context, expert placement, K/V,
vision, GPU choice or backend still makes it again. Tests (test_inkling_probe.py): the key is equal for parallel 1 / 4 / 32 and with --parallel in args; a decision recorded on the file
config is honoured by the effective config at 2 / 4 / 32 slots on cuda, hip, metal (engine_args passes --draft dspark and --parallel N; an "off" decision gives --draft off at any slot
count); the older "parallel changes the key" assertions now use backend / vram-experts instead.
```

### `505e6cbbe5bf` — server: with the DSpark drafter, a request prefers slot 0 unless another slot holds a real conversation (OPTION, owner decision, not for the rc)

- Дата: 2026-11-24
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `terminal/serve/server.py` (+9/-0)
  - `terminal/serve/test_parallel.py` (+37/-0)

- Связанные решения:
  - Прямого решения в matrix нет; изменение принято как upstream-база.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
The drafter exists only for slot 0 (strata-inkling cuda backend: the spec step returns 0 for slot != 0, taps are ingested only for slot 0). pick_slot sent a lone request to the slot
with the longest held start, else an empty one, else the one used longest ago, so at 2 or more slots a lone client mostly decoded in slot 1 or 2 without drafting while the
drafter was loaded (GRID, laptop RTX 5090, UD-Q4_K_XL: 1 slot 151.7 / 119.9 tok/s agent / chat, 2 and 3 slots 85 / 86 = drafting off). 0.2.20 had the same limit.

Fix (Inkling-2-Mini started with the drafter only, StrataEngine.drafter_in_slot_zero; every other engine and drafting off keep today's choice): when slot 0 is free and either holds the
longest start itself or the best start held elsewhere is shorter than SLOT0_PREFIX_MAX (512 tokens, STRATA_SLOT0_PREFIX; re-prefilling that costs well under a second), the request takes
slot 0. A held start of 512 tokens or more keeps its slot as before (conversation reuse); with slot 0 busy nothing changes.
Cost: an unrelated request that takes slot 0 overwrites what slot 0 held (the cache of a conversation that may come back).
Tests (serve/test_parallel.py PickSlot): the tie-break to slot 0 and the busy-slot-0 fallback, a long held start keeps its slot, a short one does not, and nothing changes for another engine
or with the drafter off.
```

### `8699881aeb4f` — fix(inkling cuda): the K/V window reserve is v0.2.20's again (UNMERGED safe option, owner decides)

- Дата: 2026-11-24
- Автор: Niko1221
- Файлы:
  - `engine/CMakeLists.txt` (+4/-0)
  - `engine/include/strata/core/ink_kv_reserve.hpp` (+22/-0)
  - `engine/src/inkling2/cuda/ink_runner.cuh` (+3/-2)
  - `engine/tests/core/ink_kv_reserve_test.cpp` (+51/-0)

- Связанные решения:
  - `expert-harness`: ours — Сохранить fork CTest/harness; upstream additions объединены без удаления sub8-off проверки.

**Исходное сообщение commit**

```
759ccf6c6 raised the runner's reserve for the workspaces it allocates after the global K/V from 640 MiB (+160 with a drafter) to 768 (+256), more than the loader
leaves for the same workspaces on a card of up to 13 GB (512 MiB, +224 with a drafter). The engine keeps 3/4 of what fits as the window of the K/V that stays on
the card, so on a 12 GB card the window fell (RTX 3060 12 GB, 32K context, 1 slot): SQ-10 7168 -> 2304 positions, UD-Q4_K_XL 5120 -> 0. Everything past the window is
read over PCIe at every decode step: GRID's final cells, SQ-10 at a 4K prompt 39.5 -> 29.2 tok/s (-26 %), UD 10.2 -> 8.9.

ink_kv_reserve.hpp holds v0.2.20's numbers and nothing else changes: for this reserve the engine behaves exactly as 0.2.20 did (the drafter's 160 MiB is counted when the file
carries a drafter, as before). Inkling CUDA only; Hy4 and the other backends are untouched.

RTX 3060 12 GB, decode tok/s at short / 4K / 16K / 30K tokens, K/V window, free MiB after the runner starts (the engine's own `memory:` line), prefill tok/s normal in every cell:
 SQ-10, drafter off  before 43.3 / 29.8 / 10.0 / 5.4  window 2304, 517 free   after 43.5 / 40.8 / 13.9 / 6.5  window 7168, 391 free   (0.2.20: 42.5 / 40.2 / 13.8 / 6.5, 7168)
 SQ-10, drafter on   before 31.9 / 29.0 / 6.9 / 3.7   window 2304, 439 free   after 31.5 / 45.8 / 9.9 / 4.4   window 7168, 313 free
 UD-Q4_K_XL, off     before 22.7 / 21.3 / 9.0 / 5.1   window 0, 439 free     after 23.9 / 35.8 / 10.8 / 5.8  window 3328, 311 free  (first 4K request, cold: 17.6 -> 27.6)
 UD-Q4_K_XL, on      after 12.1 / 30.4 / 7.0 / 4.2    window 3328, 233 free after the drafter's 78 MiB; no start-up OOM
ink_kv_reserve_test pins the values and the two measured windows (7168 and 2304) of the engine's sizing arithmetic.
```
